exam_scheme.note: BPSC Combined Competitive Examination follows a revised pattern implemented from the 69th CCE onwards: single Prelims General Studies paper with 1/3 negative marking, descriptive Mains with qualifying General Hindi and qualifying MCQ Optional paper, and 120-mark Interview. Final merit is computed out of 1,020 marks (GS1: 300 + GS2: 300 + Essay: 300 + Interview: 120).

financial_package.note: Pay figures shown for premier Level 9 postings (Bihar Administrative Service SDM, Bihar Police Service DSP). Subordinate posts recruited through CCE (e.g. Revenue Officer, Supply Inspector, Block Panchayat Raj Officer) are placed in Level 7 (basic ₹44,900).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Bihar 7th State Pay Matrix Level 9 (Grade Pay ₹5,400) adopted by Govt. of Bihar Finance Dept Resolution
financial_package.estimate_note: Range assumes Level 9 entry basic pay of ₹53,100 at standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025). Includes state HRA (8% to 18% depending on posting location in Patna or district headquarters), medical allowance (₹1,000), and transport/vehicle allowance. In-hand reflects deductions of 10% NPS (₹8,390), professional tax, and income tax.
official_perks: Government designated residential bungalow or leased official quarters
Official vehicle with driver and fuel quota for administrative field duty
Medical reimbursement under Bihar State Government Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment
Security escorts and administrative staff for executive magistrate postings
Subsidized utility allowances (electricity, telephone, official mobile internet)
